integrity: All claimed equalities follow from leaf-core decomposition and the degree-refined Prüfer count, with independent finite exact-enumeration checks; no independent scientific audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: All vertices are labelled and sampling is uniform over Cayley trees; not a binary phylogenetic sampling model.
The full finite joint enumeration is proved analytically; exhaustive computational comparisons stop at eight vertices.
Historical priority against unidentified general labelled-tree enumeration literature is not established.
title: Exact leaf-conditioned sibling-pair law for uniform labelled trees
